Spans and hashes match; identity (69 FR 46055, signed 2004-07-29) confirmed; the 11-clause inventory covers the preamble's operative acts and sections 1-10 with no gaps; EO 13364 only recites that 13350 further modified the emergency, and EO 13668 ends only EO 13303 section 1; the OFR note (Revokes ..., Amends EO 13290, Supersedes in part EO 13315) matches the order's own actions; the May 4, 2026 Iraq notice continues the EO 13303 emergency through 2026-10-14; section 1 savings are correctly described. The statement that the packet's selectable notices omit 2007-2012 is accurate in the packet's terms. Upheld after reveal.
